### [**](#forceObject)[**](https://github.com/mikro-orm/mikro-orm/blob/0b5bb40ab/packages/core/src/serialization/EntitySerializer.ts#L225)optionalforceObject

**forceObject?

<!-- -->

: boolean

Enforce unpopulated references to be returned as objects, e.g. `{ author: { id: 1 } }` instead of `{ author: 1 }`.
